note: Public US government data, downloaded for offline classroom use. catalog.data.gov has no JSON API as of 2026-08-01; these come from agency portals and the OMB GitHub mirror.

datasets.description: OMB 2025 Federal Agency AI Use Case Inventory — individually reported use cases (3,611 across 56 agencies; capped here). The course's own subject matter, as data.
OMB 2025 inventory — consolidated commercial off-the-shelf AI use cases.
City of Chicago 311 service requests (Socrata). Deliberately messy real data: blank fields, inconsistent casing, duplicate rows — the data-quality lab.
CDC wastewater surveillance for Influenza A — time series by site. The real version of the early-warning story told in Chapter 2.
EPA Annual Air Quality Index by county, 2024 — clean, small, national. Good for grouping, ranking and charting.
NYC air quality surveillance (PM2.5 and related indicators) by neighbourhood and time period — a tidy long-format table for pivots and trend questions.

synthetic_note: Written for this course, not downloaded. The labs' data rule is 'public or synthetic'; the datasets above are the public half and these are the synthetic half. Nothing here describes a real person, agency, or record. Every name, SSN, address, and case number is fabricated.

synthetic.description: Interim guidance memorandum on generative AI for constituent services, from a fictional Office of the Chief Data Officer. Five lettered rules in section 3. Source document for Labs 4.1 and 7.1.
Five synthetic case records C-1001 to C-1005. C-1005 carries a deliberate prompt-injection payload used by the Lab 7.3 guardrail stage — that is intentional, not a defect.
Cached CKAN package_search response shaped like catalog.data.gov, so dataset search works with no network. A poisoned-entry variant is built in the Lab 7.3 notebook.

Fifteen synthetic constituent messages spanning routine requests, service failures, an accessibility complaint, a privacy incident and two safety emergencies. Deliberately mixed urgency so a standard and a reasoning model disagree. Lab 4.1 rung 4.
Synthetic acceptable-use policy. RAG corpus document 1 of 4.
Synthetic data governance standard, including data stewards and approval for new uses. RAG corpus document 2 of 4.
Synthetic FOIA processing guidance: intake, fees, search, exemptions, response. RAG corpus document 3 of 4.
Synthetic records retention and destruction policy on a NARA-approved schedule. RAG corpus document 4 of 4.
Report excerpt modelled on GAO structure and banner-labelled as synthetic. Summarize task. NOT a real GAO product and must not be cited as one.
FOIA intake process in prose, condensed from the RAG corpus for the Chapter 3 Mermaid-diagram task.
Python that fails on purpose: dictionary keys are never initialised, and CSV values are summed as strings. Troubleshoot task.
Four inbound constituent letters matching cases C-1001 to C-1004. Complaint #1 is the Draft task. C-1005 is deliberately absent — its injection payload is not safe to paste into a browser assistant.
Printed prompts for the four relay tasks, used when the room has no assistant access. Distinct from labs/my_prompt_library.md, which is a Lab 4.2 output artifact.
The 1-3 rubric (accurate / complete / right format+tone) printed in the workbook for Lab 3.1.
Header-only sheet with the deliberately loose schema: your role, a beverage you drank this week, when, how much.

Thirty pre-filled rows carrying defects across all six quality dimensions: 4 blanks, 1 exact duplicate, 7 malformed dates (including 2026-02-30 and a future date), 16 non-numeric quantities, 19 beverage spellings collapsing to 14, 20 role strings for ~17 roles, and 2 stale entries. Offline fallback when the room cannot share a live sheet.
